name: Sunday Malacca Formerly Tun Fatimah
detail: senang parking, location yang bagus, nak kemana mana jalan kaki sahaja boleh sampai, sepanjang laluan riverside sangat cantik. bilik bersih, tiada sarapan pagi tapi tidak mengapa kerana harga pun sangat murah. ini kalai kedua menginap disini.. saya akan datang lagi.

name: THE REED HOTEL MELAKA
detail: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Very satisfied staying at The Reed Hotel Melaka. The price is very reasonable and affordable, but the room is still clean, tidy, and comfortable. The room is also quite spacious and suitable for relaxing peacefully. Strategic location, easy to find food stalls and other necessities around the hotel. The staff is friendly and the check-in process is easy. Definitely worth the price paid. Recommended and will definitely stay here again if I come to Melaka. 👍😊
area: Malacca City Center,Malacca - View on map

name: Sunday Malacca Near Jonker Street Formerly Quayside
detail: I am very satisfied with my 3 days and 2 nights stay at Quayside Hotel Melaka! We took a River View room - the view is really beautiful at night with the lights of the Melaka River, and the kids were excited to see the River Cruise boats passing by. The location is definitely 10/10, right next to the Water Wheel, it’s just a short walk to Jonker Street, Stadthuys & Museum. It’s easy to take little ones out without needing to drive. The room was clean, the bed was comfortable, and the air conditioner was cool. The front desk staff were very friendly and helpful. It’s truly value for money with such a prime location. Perfect for a family trip. Thank you Quayside Hotel, God willing I will visit again! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

name: Hatten Hotel Melaka
detail: Overall, I am very satisfied with my stay at this hotel. The check-in and check-out process went smoothly with the help of very friendly and professional staff. The cleanliness of the room was at its best, the mattress was very soft, and the room space felt spacious and comfortable. The breakfast menu also offered a variety of delicious local and international dishes. The hotel's location is very strategic as it is close to various amenities and attractions. I will definitely return in the future!

name: Asteria Melaka by Attic Suite
detail: This stay experience was simply perfect, I have to give it a full five-star review! 🌟 As soon as I opened the door, a wonderful scent greeted me, and the whole room was brightly lit, which perfectly matched my aesthetic since I love bright rooms! 😍 ❄️ **Well-equipped and considerate:** The air conditioning is super powerful, and the room is fully equipped with everything; you don't need to worry even if you accidentally forget your daily necessities! The TV can even watch YouTube for binge-watching, it's just wonderful～📺 🏊‍♂️ **Bonus for leisure facilities:** The hotel also has a **swimming pool** and a **gym**, whether you want to relax in the water or maintain your workout routine, it's perfect, really amazing! 💪✨ 💄 **Girls love the vanity area:** I must rave about their makeup table and wash area! The mirror has its own lighting and the brightness is adjustable🔆, and the best part is it comes with a chair, allowing makeup-loving girls to sit comfortably and take their time, it's just super nice! 💯 🛏️ **Comfort level at its peak:** The bedding is incredibly comfortable! It's so nice to sleep in that you want to stay in bed all day; this is one of the few hotels that makes me reluctant to check out! 🚗 **Great location:** It's super convenient to go anywhere! There’s a mart and various snack shops right downstairs, no need to worry about buying things or food. Next time in Malacca, I’d definitely choose this hotel with my eyes closed! 💖 Highly recommend it to all friends who are going to Malacca! Just go for it!

name: Puri Melaka
detail: I stayed at Prima Melaka as a base for sightseeing in Malacca, and I was extremely satisfied with both the location and atmosphere. First of all, the major tourist spots such as Dutch Square, Jonker Street, and along the Malacca River are within walking distance, which is very convenient. It's close enough to return to the hotel for a break during sightseeing, which was especially helpful in the hot Malacca. Once I stepped into the hotel, the lively atmosphere outside seemed to vanish, and a calm and serene space greeted me. The lobby is beautifully styled in Peranakan architecture, making it feel like entering a historic mansion. There is a Peranakan Museum nearby, but I could enjoy the charm of Peranakan architecture just within this hotel. The staff were also very kind. They not only carefully explained recommended lunch restaurants and local specialties, but they also allowed me to check in at 2 PM, which was earlier than usual and very helpful. Before my stay, I was a bit worried after reading reviews that mentioned no elevator, but it seems a new one has been installed. However, as of now, it appears to only serve up to the second floor. Breakfast could be enjoyed in the courtyard, which had a very pleasant atmosphere. While the variety wasn't extensive, I was able to spend a leisurely morning in a calm setting. The facilities themselves may not be the latest, but the interior and guest rooms were kept clean, allowing for a comfortable stay. One drawback was that while bath towels were provided, it would have been better if face towels were also available. Overall, the balance of location, atmosphere, and price is very good, and I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Malacca.

name: Swiss-Garden Hotel Melaka
detail: It's a bit far from the center of Malacca, but the location is good because it's nice to walk along the river. The breakfast is fine if you're not averse to local food. However, if you're expecting something like a 4-5 star hotel in Vietnam, you might be disappointed. The swimming pool can be seen as separate from the children's pool. The adult pool is quite spacious. The condition of the rooms is similar to other 4-star hotels, and there is plenty of space.

name: Swiss Heritage Boutique Hotel Jonker Street Melaka
detail: It is located at the entrance of Jonker Walk Street, providing a geographical advantage to walk to various tourist attractions. The facilities feel somewhat old, and the bathroom drainage was not smooth, but the staff were friendly, and there are many advantages in various ways, so I recommend it!

name: The Apple Premier Suites Melaka
detail: The overall experience was very satisfactory. The room was spacious and clean, with sufficient hot water supply, and the swimming pool facilities were great. The location was convenient, with a pleasant walking experience and easy access to the surrounding environment. The staff were friendly and attentive, offering excellent value for money. The facilities were comprehensive and met various needs. Overall, it was a pleasant stay experience and is highly recommended.
area: Malacca City Center,Malacca - View on map

name: Aava Malacca Hotel
detail: There is no elevator here, so if this is a concern for you, do not choose to stay on the second floor. The rooms are clean and the staff are very friendly. It is a standard Nanyang-style shophouse, very beautiful, with high ceilings, not overly complicated in decoration, providing a simple, clear, and spacious feeling. There is also a door by the riverside for entry and exit. Access requires a key card both in and out, providing a sense of security. I did not choose a room with a window facing the street. The hotel and its surroundings are very quiet, making it very comfortable for resting and vacationing. I guess it was because I went during a time that was not a weekend and did not stay in the core area of Petaling Street.
